specNote: Specifications shown here are taken from the supplied catalogue. Consult the current product documentation and instructions for use for clinical decisions and availability.
smartSpecs: The BIOSmart catalogue presents 3.5, 4.0, 4.5 and 5.5 mm diameter groups, and a separate short implant group. Refer to the original tables for length and reference combinations.
monoblockSpecs: The supplied catalogue describes a one-piece design and presents diameter and length tables. Consult the original catalogue for references and configurations.
zygomaSpecs: The supplied Zygomatic product table lists a 4.2 mm diameter and nine lengths from 35 to 55 mm.
promxSpecs: The supplied VTX Two Piece catalogue lists a 2.42 mm internal hex connection, SLA surface and size tables.
productSource: Product imagery and information are sourced from the supplied catalogues.
aboutIntro: BioVent Dental Implant Systems brings together implant lines and prosthetic product resources for dental professionals and prospective distribution partners.
aboutCopy: Our portfolio includes Smart, Zygoma, Monoblock and ProMX implant lines. Explore their original catalogues to review the systems, components and product details.
aboutProofCopy: We provide access to the supplied technical catalogues so prospective partners can review the portfolio before a commercial conversation.
aboutMarketsCopy: Distribution enquiries begin with your company, territory and product interests. Commercial terms and market availability are discussed directly.
distributorIntro: Start with your company and your ambitions. Prepare a partnership enquiry covering your territory and product interests.

chooseProducts: Select at least one product line.

faq1: Can I enquire about a specific territory?
faq1Answer: Yes. Include the country or territory you operate in. Territory availability and any exclusivity must be discussed with the BioVent team.
faq2: Can I request information on a single product line?
faq2Answer: Yes. Select one or more implant lines in your enquiry and consult the relevant product catalogue.
faq3: Where can I find product specifications?
faq3Answer: The Resources section contains the original BIOSmart and BioVent catalogues. Product pages also highlight selected source specifications.
resourcesIntro: Review the original supplied catalogues for product details, size tables and prosthetic components.
resourceNote: The original PDFs retain their catalogue product names. Website product names follow the confirmed BioVent portfolio naming.
privacyCopy: This prototype has no enquiry backend, analytics or tracking cookies. Form entries are held only in the current page and are not sent to a server. Changing the page clears the form. Downloading an enquiry saves a text file to your device. Language selection is included in the URL without storing personal details.
